span.p:
All controllers extend ControllerBase; dependencies arrive by
constructor injection (the private fields). Optional string
parameters default to null. Access rules:
AuthController: anonymous, except Me (signed in). Login,
ForgotPassword, Register, ResetPassword: auth-strict rate limit.
LeadsController: CreateLead anonymous (agentService from
FromServices); GetLeads, UpdateLeadStatus Admin or Consultant.
CasesController: signed in. AssignConsultant Admin only;
GetCase, GetClientCases any role; the rest Admin or Consultant.
